what_we_offer_items.title: PR Card Renewal or Replacement
what_we_offer_items.description: Your PR card is required for travel and proof of permanent residency. We assist with renewal applications, lost/stolen card replacements, and urgent processing requests. We also help you explain any shortfall in your residency days.

what_we_offer_items.title: Permanent Resident Travel Document (PRTD)
what_we_offer_items.description: If you're a permanent resident outside Canada without a valid PR card, you'll need a PRTD to return. We help you gather the right documentation to prove residency compliance and submit your application to a Canadian visa office abroad.

what_we_offer_items.title: Canadian Citizenship Applications
what_we_offer_items.description: Ready to take the final step? We evaluate your eligibility, calculate your physical presence days, and prepare your full citizenship application—including help with travel history, tax documents, language proof, and PR compliance.

faq_items.question: Can I apply for citizenship if my PR card is expired?
faq_items.answer: Yes. Your PR card does not need to be valid to apply for citizenship—but your status must be intact.

faq_items.question: How many days must I live in Canada to renew my PR card?
faq_items.answer: You must meet the 730-day residency obligation within the last 5 years.

faq_items.question: How many days are needed for citizenship?
faq_items.answer: You must have been physically present in Canada for at least 1,095 days during the past 5 years.

faq_items.question: Can I apply for a PR card from outside Canada?
faq_items.answer: No. PR cards can only be sent to Canadian addresses. You'll need a PRTD if you're abroad without a valid card.

faq_items.question: Do I need to pass a test for citizenship?
faq_items.answer: Yes, if you're between 18 and 54. It covers Canadian history, government, geography, and rights/responsibilities.

faq_items.question: What will be the processing time?
faq_items.answer: Processing times may vary depending on volume and complexity. Visit the IRCC website for current timelines.
